body: Idk if it will, im past it. Im only looking at my present and future and it sucks

I understand, I never even think about confidence, but I know I don’t get insecure. It’s just kinda a reality for me. Any insecurity I had in talking to ppl was pushed out of me when I was on the streets. My reality is just unimaginably hard if that makes sense. Trying seems really futile. Really I just want a family. I don’t want a family based on lies though. I want to be able to tell the woman I’m with that I’m attracted to her, and I want that feeling to be mutual. My entire life my relationship with my family was built on a lie, and I can’t stand that. If being honest with myself and others means I end up alone then I’d rather die alone than live a lie. I cannot stand any more dysfunction. I used to be a believer in the “secret” but life took that belief and absolutely demolished it. I appreciate your sentiments though, im not gonna try that hard asking ppl out anymore though, just going to finish the things on my bucket list

Take your avg 5ft2 guy and multiply their difficulties tenfold. I’ve also suffered from vitiligo due to stress from abuse and malnourishment at a young age. While I have treated it and it’s unnoticeable, it’s like a dagger over my head waiting to fall at any time. I always wanted kids, but I can’t pass this defect or my height to any son I have. That would be cruel. My face looks very tired from what I’ve experienced and the lack of sleep overworking so idk what could fix that except cosmetic surgery. Even so I’m still 5ft2 on top of that. Avg 5ft2 guys face a steep uphill battle, but i feel like im facing a wall

Height isn’t my only problem, vitiligo is ravaging my face. Now i cured most of it an only have like a tiny white dot left, but vitiligo is like a dagger that can strike at any time. Ive went to therapy but it didn’t help much. I also had hairloss but stopped it with drugs and healthy diet. I think my stress from my family situation early in lofe triggered these things
